SELECT a.*,
(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(a.keywords, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') THEN 4 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(a.summary, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOWER(a.search_content) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
0 AS relevance, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM kb_article_annotation n WHERE n.article_id = a.id AND n.status = 1) AS annotation_count FROM kb_article a WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND a.deleted = 0
AND a.status = #{status}
AND (
LOWER(a.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(a.keywords, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(a.summary, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') OR LOWER(a.search_content) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%')
)
ORDER BY
relevance DESC,
a.update_time DESC, a.id DESC
